cases.name: F1 (Ultra-Selective 0.01%)
cases.description: Point lookup exercising metadata min/max pruning and dictionary filters

cases.name: F2 (Moderate Filter 5%)
cases.description: Categorical filter selecting ~5% of row groups

cases.name: F3 (Pathological Low-Selectivity 99.5%)
cases.description: Pathological filter that prunes almost nothing; tests pushdown evaluation overhead
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt, sum("ResolutionWidth") AS total_res FROM t WHERE "AdvEngineID" >= 0

cases.name: F4 (High-Cardinality IN List 50 items)
cases.description: High-cardinality IN list filter spanning many values

cases.name: F5 (Compound Negation & Range)
cases.description: Compound NOT IN, inequality, and numeric inequality range filters
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM t WHERE "RegionID" NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) AND "AdvEngineID" <> 0 AND "ResolutionWidth" > 1920

cases.name: F6 (Prefix String Filter)
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM t WHERE "MobilePhoneModel" LIKE 'iPhone%'

cases.name: F7 (Unanchored Substring Filter)
cases.description: Arbitrary unanchored substring search across text column
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM t WHERE "SearchPhrase" LIKE '%vector%'
